text:
nina: flagged by partner-alert: plaintext KMS key path surfaced in partner debug blob. need quick triage and rotation plan.

paul: pulled the blob. contains projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/sync/cryptoKeys/partner-sync-key in a debug dump. appears in 6 forwarded audit lines.

chris: do we have decrypt attempts from unknown principals? quick KMS audit check?

maria: KMS audit shows allowed decrypts from svc-partner-relay@partner during the window, but external-splunk got 6 lines with the key path unredacted. treat as data exposure.

nina: immediate actions: (A) stop forwarding those audit lines externally (disable forwarder filter), (B) re-add any missing decrypt principals if failures start, (C) rotate key with rewrap, (D) revoke long-lived vault tokens used by partner.

vault-bot: alert: vault-audit-forwarder forwarded 6 entries matching "/keyRings/.+/cryptoKeys/.+" to external index. Marked for redaction.

paul: I'll disable external forwarding for matching patterns now.

paul: done at 11:02 UTC. holding for validation.

chris: recommend creating a new key version, use aliasing in Vault to switch with minimal churn, then rewrap ciphertexts in partner namespace in small batches. also coordinate partner window.

nina: sounds good. maria, can you draft a Conftest policy to block PRs that partially remove principals on google_kms_crypto_key or google_project_iam_binding? we cannot have accidental partial diffs.

maria: yes. rule idea: any diff touching kms keys must either include full principals list or fail. i'll prototype a Conftest rego and gate it in CI.

chris: i'll prepare a rewrap script: dry-run mode to decrypt->encrypt a sample, then iterate ciphertexts with backoff and per-service rate limit. will expose status to a metrics endpoint.

nina: we also need to scrub any backups/snapshots that might have captured the debug dump. paul can you scan nightly backups for key path strings and mark any hits for secure erase?

paul: on it. kicking off grep scan across backup snapshots.

vault-bot: notice: backup-scan found 2 snapshots containing the key path string. scheduled a scrub job; retention updated.

maria: for short-term mitigation: add an allow binding for svc-partner-relay to ensure no outages during rotation. command: gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:svc-partner-relay@partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter

chris: adding that now and will monitor proxy errors.

chris: binding added at 11:12 UTC. partner traffic normal.

nina: owners: chris (rewrap script + run), maria (CI gate + Conftest), paul (backup scan + scrub), nina (partner advisory + compliance notif). please update INC ticket.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1368 - "keypath-exposure-and-rotate" assigned to oncall. impact: low-medium.

maria: timeline: emergency forwarder stop + binding done. rewrap runbook draft in 2h, Conftest prototype in 4h, partner advisory in 1h.

nina: thanks team. we'll run rotation in a controlled window and keep partners informed. reopen if any failures occur. :lock:
